summary:
Suhail is a futuristic mobile wellness application developed for astronauts aboard the International Space Station (ISS). Inspired by the guiding star Canopus, Suhail addresses critical physiological and psychological spaceflight challenges, such as circadian rhythm disruption and microgravity-induced bone and nutrient decline. 

Built with React Native and featuring a clean white-and-blue interface, Suhail integrates three core features: (1) Mood-Based Meal Recommendations with an operational confirmation lock to prevent accidental inputs, (2) Predictive Vitamin Deficiency Nutrition that forecasts potential shortages using NASA RDA benchmarks, and (3) Orbital Sleep Regulation to synchronize rest cycles with ISS 90-day sunrise/sunset periods. 

Suhail is important because it shifts astronaut healthcare from reactive treatment to proactive, daily prevention, ensuring optimal crew performance and well-being for deep-space exploration missions.
details:
Suhail is an advanced mobile health and wellness application engineered specifically for astronauts aboard the International Space Station (ISS). Inspired by Canopus (Suhail), the historic navigational guiding star, the app bridges critical gaps in astronaut physiological and psychological self-care during long-duration spaceflight.

- What it does & How it works: Suhail provides a clean, futuristic white-and-blue interface built with React Native and Expo. It integrates three core modules: (1) Mood-Based Meal Recommendations that adjust food intake based on daily emotional states (featuring an operational confirmation lock to prevent accidental microgravity inputs), (2) Predictive Vitamin Deficiency Nutrition that calculates nutrient gaps against NASA RDA benchmarks to suggest preventive meals, and (3) Orbital Sleep Regulation to stabilize disrupted circadian rhythms during 90-minute ISS orbital day-night cycles.

- Benefits & Impact: It shifts astronaut healthcare from reactive treatment to proactive, daily prevention, mitigating microgravity-induced bone density loss, nutritional depletion, and sleep fatigue.

- Tech Stack & Tools: Developed using JavaScript, React Native, Expo, and UI design patterns in Figma, with Claude (LLM) assisting in code structure and component design.
